title: AiSettings
description: GET/PUT /local/ai/settings: how the owner's AI processes new mail and chat (docs/plans/local/contracts.md section 3).

executor.description: claude_code and codex run the owner's signed-in CLI in the background; conversation_only waits for get_pending_mail in an AI conversation.

model.description: Optional model name passed to the CLI (a cheaper, faster one is better for extraction).

background_acknowledged.description: The owner confirmed in onboarding that background processing uses their own AI subscription and may count against its limits. Required before claude_code or codex runs.
